documents.title: Halting is final — after the residual reaches 0, no later index is taken
header: > After halting at `N₀`, no later index is taken (the residual stays `0` and `α > 0`).

documents.title: Theorem 5 (C1 regime) — p(L) = L + 1 below the gap, a_0 and N - a_0 - 1
header: > **Theorem 5 (C1 regime).** If `L` is at most the minimal gap, at most `a_0` and at most `N - a_0 - 1`, then `p(L) = L + 1`.

documents.title: Corollary 3 (decay) — the complexity decays linearly to N - L + 1
header: > **Corollary 3 (decay).** For `L ≥ max(span, a_m+1, N - a_m - 1)` the complexity decays linearly, `p(L) = N - L + 1`.

documents.title: Theorem 8 (first half) — rational termination of the greedy residual
documents.source_line: ** [`research/twin-prime-parity/rounds/rh41/lean/Rh41/GreedyResidual.lean`](../research/twin-prime-parity/rounds/rh41/lean/Rh41/GreedyResidual.lean) — lines 354–358 (`Rh41.Harmonic.terminates_of_pos_lt_one`); lines 360–364 (`Rh41.Harmonic.terminates_rat`); lines 298–302 (`Rh41.Harmonic.terminates_aux`); lines 373–377 (`Rh41.Harmonic.terminates_from`); lines 379–384 (`Rh41.Harmonic.residual_eventually_zero`); lines 151–157 (`Rh41.Harmonic.num_sub_inv_lt`)
header: **Source:** [`research/twin-prime-parity/rounds/rh41/lean/Rh41/GreedyResidual.lean`](../research/twin-prime-parity/rounds/rh41/lean/Rh41/GreedyResidual.lean) — lines 354–358 (`Rh41.Harmonic.terminates_of_pos_lt_one`); lines 360–364 (`Rh41.Harmonic.terminates_rat`); lines 298–302 (`Rh41.Harmonic.terminates_aux`); lines 373–377 (`Rh41.Harmonic.terminates_from`); lines 379–384 (`Rh41.Harmonic.residual_eventually_zero`); lines 151–157 (`Rh41.Harmonic.num_sub_inv_lt`)
> **Theorem 8 (first half).** Every positive rational below `1` terminates under the greedy rule.
> **Theorem 8 (first half), `p/q` form.** For `0 < p < q` the greedy residual of `p/q` reaches `0` at some finite step.
> **Theorem 8 (first half), general-index form.** From any step index `i`, a positive rational residual below `1/(i+1)` reaches `0` in finitely many steps.

documents.title: Theorem 12 (impossibility half), quantitative form — no linear complexity profile
header: > **Theorem 12 (impossibility half), quantitative form.** For every finite support `S` and every `c > 0` there are `N`, `L` with `1 ≤ L ≤ N` and `p(L) < c·L`: a linear profile is impossible.

documents.title: The greedy on a finite list: its total is a sub-sum and it never overshoots a non-negative target
header: > For a list `l` of rationals and a target `x`:
> - the greedy total `greedySum l x` is a sub-sum: `greedySum l x ∈ subSums l`;

documents.title: A gap of exactly 2 forces rh41's C1 minimum-gap parameter to satisfy `L ≤ 2`
header: > If a support has a gap equal to `2`, then rh41's C1 hypothesis `GapsAtLeast S L` forces `L ≤ 2`. Combined with `support_gap_even`, this is the honest structural consequence of the parity lock for the complexity law.
